tool_args.rationale: The irregular raw prefixes and coupled-transient signature support the archived two-state memory ODE, but five rows leave its parameters insufficiently identified. The trajectory batch supplies the additional observations needed to fit and test it.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled memory ODE using the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The four-parameter model is not sufficiently identified by five forecast observations; the archive calls for at least eight rows.
The observed history gap and coupled transient lag favor the memory mechanism, whereas this probe targets sink-gradient branch ambiguity.
It does not directly account for the observed dependence on the raw history.
